title: Borrowing a book
passage: The campus library opens at eight. Students need a card to borrow books. The ground floor is for group work, and the top floor is quiet.

questions.question: What do students need in order to borrow books?
questions.explanation: The passage says students need a card to borrow books.

questions.question: Which floor is quiet?
questions.explanation: The top floor is quiet. The ground floor is for group work.

questions.question: What time does the library open?
questions.explanation: The first sentence says the library opens at eight.
